SearchFormDefinition.name: SearchDefUserCommodityProfileMapping
SearchFormDefinition.Source: select distinct us.userId,us.userName,cp.profileName as profileName,r.roleName,us.userKey from Users us join us.role r join us.userProfileMapping cp
SearchFormDefinition.ExtractSource: select distinct us.userId,cp.profileName as profileName,r.roleName from Users us join us.role r join us.userProfileMapping cp

Text.name: profileName
Text.Expression: exists (select 1 from CommodityProfile commProf join commProf.itemCategory ic where cp.itemCategory = ic and lower(cp.profileName) like lower(:profileName))

Text.name: companyItemType
Text.Expression: exists (select 1 from CommodityProfile commProf join commProf.itemCategory ic where cp.itemCategory = ic and lower(cp.companyItemType) like lower(:companyItemType))

Text.name: categoryName
Text.Expression: exists (select 1 from CommodityProfile commProf join commProf.itemCategory ic where cp.itemCategory = ic and lower(ic.categoryName) like lower(:categoryName))
